title: Oxfmt format-check executor
description: Check that a project is formatted with oxfmt --check (ideal for CI).

projectRoot.description: Project root relative to the workspace root. Defaults to the current project root.

config.description: Path to an oxfmt configuration file relative to the workspace root.

patterns.description: Glob patterns relative to the project root. When omitted, the project root is checked.

noErrorOnUnmatchedPattern.description: Do not exit with an error when a pattern is unmatched.

args.description: Additional CLI arguments forwarded to oxfmt.
